title: publish RC8 mirror metadata and frontend consistency refresh

files.role: RC8 mirror metadata and frontend refresh publisher

criteria: RC8 metadata is published to the HTTPS mirror as metadata-only descriptors, receipts, preflight evidence, fail-closed evidence, channel index, install bootstrap, and mirror status without hosting payload bytes on the mirror.
The refreshed frontend renders the RC8 real payload mirror state and reads the RC8 metadata endpoints without external dependencies.

HTTPS validation uses resolve-pinned curl and proves live endpoint reachability, RC8 hash binding consistency, preserved compatibility/rollback/support metadata, directory listing denial, and POST denial.

The mirror keeps production_ready_claim=false and install, activation, rollback execution, payload upload, remote payload download, production ring mutation, support upload, remote dispatch, and TUI authority blocked.
